dedupe_keys.name: high voltage disconnector state identification synthetic and real images of substation disconnectors

description: Victor Barpp Gomes and colleagues publish images for identifying the open or closed state of high-voltage substation disconnectors. Zenodo serves four type-specific ZIPs under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 at no cost. The page reports about 940,000 rendered and 60,000 camera images, each 320 by 128 pixels, for 230 kV and 525 kV switch designs. Separate folders contain synthetic training, limited real training, ordinary real tests and real switching-manoeuvre tests. The images can train or validate visual-state estimators used in substation monitoring simulations and digital twins. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this image benchmark; SANDI-2024 concerns network packets instead. A limitation is that synthetic-to-real transfer and site-specific camera placement may affect performance, and the non-commercial share-alike licence constrains reuse. The ZIPs were not downloaded, and counts, labels and model accuracy were not independently checked.
